description: We are Just Beans, the best team there ever was. A very long time ago, a simple man named Albert Einstein once said: "Oh Just Beans, Oh Just Beans, if you don't win 2026 NASA Space Apps Competition then you will forever just be Just Beans". Now that was a very big risk to take of course, but despite that here we stand.. Beans. Other than the fact our name might be lame we stand firm, healthy and strong willed to achieve that 1st place. (dinner on us if you let us win, straight beans. JUST BEANS)
